name: u/carol: lobby → PLAY → play H1 possessions → STOP at halftime summary (NUM_PERIODS=2, so the only summary is halftime)

steps._comment: Pre-match energy — match costs 1. If this is 0/5 the block modal fires and matchmaking never opens.

steps.expression: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('[data-testid^="levelup-ability-"]'); window.__ups = (window.__ups ?? 0) + 1; return a ? a.getAttribute('data-testid') : ''; })()

(() => { const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="play-"]')].filter(e => e.getAttribute('data-testid') !== 'play-picker'); const ok = all.filter(e => e.getAttribute('data-disabled') === '0' && e.getAttribute('data-testid') !== 'play-iso'); const p = ok[0] || all.find(e => e.getAttribute('data-disabled') === '0') || all[0]; window.__plays = (window.__plays ?? 0) + 1; return p ? p.getAttribute('data-testid') : ''; })()

(() => { const d = document.querySelector('[data-testid="defense-motion"], [data-testid="defense-guard"], [data-testid="defense-aggressive"]'); window.__defs = (window.__defs ?? 0) + 1; return d ? d.getAttribute('data-testid') : ''; })()

steps._comment: NOTE: the quarter-summary-continue click from carol-play-full-match is deliberately REMOVED — that overlay is the stop condition, not something to dismiss.
Let the summary panel fade in (FADE_TICKS) so its text is readable

steps.expression: JSON.stringify({plays: window.__plays ?? 0, defenses: window.__defs ?? 0, upgrades: window.__ups ?? 0, period: document.querySelector('[data-testid="quarter"]')?.textContent, time: document.querySelector('[data-testid="timer"]')?.textContent, home: document.querySelector('[data-testid="score-home"]')?.textContent, away: document.querySelector('[data-testid="score-away"]')?.textContent, atSummary: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid="quarter-summary"]'), gameOver: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid="game-over-screen"]')})

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[data-testid="quarter-summary"]'); if (!s) return 'NO-SUMMARY'; const t = [...s.querySelectorAll('[data-text]')].map(e => e.getAttribute('data-text')); return t.join('|').slice(0,200); })()
steps._comment: PixelText renders pixel RECTS, not text nodes - textContent is always ''. Reads the data-text attr added to PixelText instead.
ASSERT: loop exited via the halftime summary, NOT by exhausting max. Placed after extract+screenshot so diagnostics survive a failure.
ASSERT: recap says HALF, not QUARTER. Guards the NUM_PERIODS=2 halves relabel (QuarterSummary.jsx qNames) against regression.
